address: Estrada da Lagoa Azul, Sintra, 2714-511, Portugal
bio: The Penha Longa Resort is an exclusive complex, both due to its location in the Sintra-Cascais Natural Park and its luxurious facilities… boasting views of a golf course! The experience at Lab by Sergi Arola, featuring a cocktail bar and an impressive glass-walled wine cellar, begins with a variety of appetisers or tapas laid out on a large table shaped like Portugal, taking us on a tour of the country’s flavours (Algarve prawns, Bairrada suckling pig, Serra da Estrela cheese, Trás-os-Montes alheira sausage...).
